b007:
• 把所有文件都带来：成绩单、证书、证明、学生手册——任何语言都可以，哪怕是手机里的照片。
  • 学校会评估这些文件，并可能为已经通过的课程给学分：数学、科学、社会研究，而且你的母语可以算作外语学分。
  • 7–8 年级（相当于初中）通常对应 middle school；9 年级及以上（相当于高中）可以折算成 high school 学分。
  • 没有文件？学校仍会按年龄安排年级，有些科目可以通过考试获得学分。要问一问。
  • 要求学校书面给出评估结果，并保存一份。如果缺少某个学分，请辅导员和 EL 老师一起复核。

b013: Newcomer note: a student can attend public high school until age 21 in Mississippi, so a 5-year plan is allowed and often wise for students who arrive at 16–17 with little English. Ask the counselor about it in 9th or 10th grade, not senior year. 可以上学到 21 岁；五年计划是可行的——要早点问。
b014: Seal of Biliteracy · 双语能力印章: Mississippi puts a seal on the diploma of students who show proficiency in English and another language. English counts with an ELPT score of 4 in all domains, English II test score of 4, ACT English 18, SAT 320 or AP English 3; the other language with AP (3), AAPPL or STAMP Intermediate-Mid (I4/L4) in all four skills, or a portfolio for languages without a test. Your home language is an asset — ask the counselor in 10th or 11th grade.
